cues: Ploidy questions come every year, and one rule answers them all.
Anything belonging to the mother plant is two n.
Anything in the gametophyte is n.
Only the two products of double fertilization differ: the embryo is two n, the endosperm three n.
And the perisperm of black pepper, which is leftover nucellus, is two n.
